topic: Data cleanup and storage strategy discussion
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on optimizing data handling, specifically regarding deletion and storage of historical records. Improvements were noted for the `ml_2` script to enhance deletion speed. Regarding session data, there was a discussion about implementing a retention policy, with one participant suggesting that old sessions should not be stored indefinitely in S3 (suggesting a 2-year limit). Another participant argued against limiting storage on S3.

Technical discussions included optimizing the process for checking if data exists before running full cleanup scripts. One participant confirmed they would revert to moving old records into `device_session_archive`. The conversation concluded with praise for new features related to S3 integration and partial data retrieval.
decisions: Implement a retention policy for session data, limiting storage (suggested 2 years)
Move old device session records back to the dedicated archive table (`device_session_archive`)
action_items: Investigate and implement logic to check for existing data before running full cleanup scripts.
